title: Ergonomic credential swapper and lightweight stream adapter for multi-SDK parity
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Teams reported that credential rotation and stream consumer ergonomics still required per-SDK boilerplate and fragile window-handling (time-based TTL checks + ad-hoc backoff). This PR introduces a small, well-documented runtime-agnostic credential swapper and a lightweight stream adapter that normalizes generator/pullstream ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Goals: (1) Provide a single credential profile format (json/yaml doc + typed bindings) so SDKs can offer the same default behavior; (2) Offer an ergonomic token-swapper API that minimizes surface area (start/stop, lease callbacks, fallback chain); (3) Supply a generator-friendly stream facade that supports pause/resume, checkpointed resume tokens, and explicit heartbeat hints without changing underlying transport protocols; (4) Bump SDK minimums where needed and add compatibility tests. Changeset summary: - Added credentials/profile schema and docs at sdk/credentials/schema.md - Implemented a tiny `CredentialSwapper` shim in python/ts/go SDKs with the same semantic surface (Start(), RefreshIfNeeded(), Handoff()) - Introduced `stream-facade` helpers that wrap transport iterables and expose a small, language-idiomatic API: pause(), resume(), checkpoint() - Added end-to-end parity tests in internal/e2e/cred-stream-parity (matrix py/ts/go across node/python runner) - CI: expanded the matrix with a credential rotation stress job and reduced flakiness by adding deterministic time helpers - Docs: cross-SDK snippets and a migration guide under docs/sdk/migrations/cred-swapper.md Migration notes: existing consumers that implemented their own token rotation should continue to work; recommended path is to adopt the swapper by calling CredentialSwapper.wrap(existingProvider()) and opt into the new heartbeat hints. Checklist: - [x] Credential profile schema and examples - [x] Implementations for Python, TypeScript, Go - [x] Cross-SDK unit and e2e parity tests - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] Version bumps: python v1.29.0, ts v1.27.3, go v1.8.0 - [x] CI matrix updated Tests and validation: described in test_plan below. Backwards compat: design preserves existing provider interfaces via adapter helpers; breaking_change=false. Related: ENG-3214 (auth-lease-stability), SDK-908 (stream-ergonomics).
